answer: The orchard holds work receipts rather than names, so the harbor of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. By the delta of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
